purpose: saved-OOF subgroup screening; not hidden-test reconstruction

composite_stage_definition.M1 distant/metastatic: M starts with M1, regardless of T or N
composite_stage_definition.M0 N1-3 node-positive: M0 and N is N1, N2, or N3
composite_stage_definition.M0 N0 T0-2 localized: M0, N0, and T is T0, T1*, or T2*
composite_stage_definition.M0 N0 T3-4 locally advanced: M0, N0, and T is T3 or T4*
composite_stage_definition.M0 indeterminate T/N: M0 with T or N not classifiable above
composite_stage_definition.EOD unavailable (all blank): T, N, and M are all Blank(s)
composite_stage_definition.EOD not applicable (88): T, N, and M are all code 88

bootstrap.method: paired stratified bootstrap; fixed 84.5% rank policy re-applied per sample

caveats: Binary Dead-class F1 is retained only to reconcile legacy local analyses.
archive/oof_nn.npy is ordinary OOF, not jointly nested with pseudo90.
A subgroup feature or weight still requires full leakage-safe nested retraining.
